folds.title: Knowledge cutoff
points: Claude learned from text collected up to a certain date: its **knowledge cutoff**.
Anything newer is not in its head.
Like last week's news, a new phone, or the latest version of an app.

folds.title: Web search
points: With **web search** on, Claude can look things up and read current pages.
Without it, Claude only has what it learned.

folds.title: Without and with search

chat.label: Search off
chat.you: What's the newest model of my phone?
chat.claude: As far as I know, it's the Model 5.

chat.label: Search on
chat.claude: I checked the maker's site: it's now the Model 7.

folds.note: Without search, Claude only knows what it learned.

folds.title: For anything that changes
items: Or tell it the version or date you mean.
Then check the sources it gives.

folds.prompt: Does this need a web search, or can Claude just answer?

items.why: This knowledge is old and stable.
